sinopsis.es: Una célebre bailarina del Moulin Rouge, desestabilizada por las palabras despectivas de su ex coreógrafo, viaja a casa con su hermana. Allí, un benefactor adinerado y viejos conocidos la obligan a cuestionar el precio de su arte.
sinopsis.en: A celebrated Moulin Rouge performer, destabilized by her former choreographer's dismissive words, travels home with her sister. There, a wealthy patron and old acquaintances force her to question the price of her art.
